C-GRAPH-RUNTIME-PATHS.Name: Repair the stale current-state source paths for M-010 and M-016
C-GRAPH-RUNTIME-PATHS.ApprovalBasis: Owner instruction in chat on 2026-10-27 («го») accepting refresh finding F3: the runtime graph still names the pre-split files for two backend modules, so `grace module show` navigates to paths that no longer exist.
C-GRAPH-RUNTIME-PATHS.Summary: `.grace/graph/runtime.xml` declares `src-tauri/src/security.rs` as M-010's source and `src-tauri/src/updater/mod.rs` as M-016's, and repeats the former as the test anchor; both files were retired when the backend moved to one module per file (`m010_security.rs`, `m016_updater.rs`), and the `Path` and `KnowledgeGraphPath` entries already point at the new names. The mismatch survives because nothing resolves Sources paths at lint time. This change corrects the two Source/Tests entries and drops a test anchor (`test/specs/security/xss.spec.js`) that no longer exists; the frozen GRACE 3 `LegacyBase` provenance blocks are left untouched.

Problem.Description: Two runtime modules name retired files in their current-state Sources/Tests, so module navigation and source audits resolve to paths that do not exist.

Goals.R-1: M-010's Source and Tests name src-tauri/src/m010_security.rs; the retired test/specs/security/xss.spec.js anchor is gone.
Goals.R-2: M-016's Source and Tests name src-tauri/src/m016_updater.rs.
Goals.R-3: The frozen LegacyBase blocks and every other historical entry stay byte-identical.

Constraints.Constraint: No behaviour, test, workflow or release change — the diff is confined to two Sources blocks in .grace/graph/runtime.xml.
Frozen GRACE 3 provenance (LegacyBase, docs/*.xml) is not edited; the V-M-016 LegacyBase still cites the historical file.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Re-auditing every historical anchor in the graph; the refresh scan found these two and nothing else.
Removing LegacyBase or migrating GRACE 3 provenance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Neither `src-tauri/src/security.rs` nor `src-tauri/src/updater/mod.rs` appears in a current-state Sources element; m010_security.rs / m016_updater.rs appear instead.
grace lint --assertions current reports the recorded baseline (0 errors) and the repo-path scan over .grace/graph finds no missing declared sources.

C-GRAPH-RUNTIME-PATHS.VerificationIntent: grep checks over .grace/graph/runtime.xml; node repo-path scan; grace lint --path . --change C-GRAPH-RUNTIME-PATHS --assertions final --run-commands; grace lint --path . --assertions current.

Approval.ApprovedBy: owner (chat, 2026-10-27): «го» after the refresh report (finding F3)
Approval.ApprovalScope: Current-state graph correction only; no version, tag or publication.
